name: Seidou Tsurumi
source:
Likes: Green tea, children.
Dislikes: Carrots.

A third year student at Seidou Gakuen who is the granddaughter of the headmaster. Tsurumi is also the leader of the "Administration Department" and as such she is the most charismatic and popular student in her school. Tsurumi has an aloof and strict personality and she despises pathetic and worthless men.

[Translated from [url=https://gyutto.com/af-256/i/item12618?map=end%3f&select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url].]
